note: Ninth batch: second gates for the topics that had one, and Cambridge problems put first where a gate used the NST Workbook or a textbook. Problems: the STEP Questions Database LaTeX source of each STEP paper a new gate comes from (one file per paper; kind tex, extracted as its own text); IA Analysis I Example Sheet 1 (DPMMS, 2025-26; www.dpmms.cam.ac.uk sends an incomplete certificate chain, so fetch.mjs downloads it with the system curl, TLS verification on); Computer Science Tripos Part IA Paper 1 questions (2013 and 2016 in Standard ML, restated in OCaml and marked adapted; 2022 in OCaml); and the STEP Support STEP 2 Trigonometry and Matrices modules (questions, solutions, and the module pages that link them; the Matrices questions are Oxford and Cambridge A level questions reproduced by permission of Cambridge Assessment Group Archives). Official answers: STEP hints, solutions, mark schemes, and examiners' reports for 2004 to 2018, from the folder of past STEP papers that the STEP Questions Database page links (a Google Drive folder; the download URL redirects from drive.google.com to drive.usercontent.google.com, both listed in hosts). They support gates and are compared with computed answers; they are not gate documents. Two are scans with no text layer (2004 hints, 2014 STEP I mark scheme), read from page images. Each source records its author, licence, licence URL, and the terms printed on the document or its site; fetch.mjs reads only id, course, kind, role, title, and url.
